start: Settings, Workouts group, a member with the default rest set

steps.action: Tap 'Rest timer and sounds'
user_sees: Title 'Rest timer and sounds'
Rows 'Default rest' (the time or 'Off'), 'Workout sounds', 'Rest-over sound', 'Show "In use" screen after each set'
must_not: The default rest shown as 'Off' while one is set

steps.action: Tap 'Default rest' and pick 2:00
user_sees: Sheet 'Default rest', 'Used for every exercise that has no rest time of its own.'
The sheet closes; the row shows 2:00
must_not: The row showing the old time after the sheet closes

steps.action: Tap 'Rest-over sound' and pick another sound
user_sees: The sound plays once as a preview; the row shows its name
must_not: The old sound ringing at the end of the next rest

steps.action: Start a workout and tick a set on an exercise with no rest of its own
user_sees: The rest timer starts at 2:00
must_not: The timer starting at the old default

start: Settings, Workouts group, weekly goal Off

steps.action: Tap 'Weekly goal'
user_sees: Title 'Weekly goal'
Big 'Off' between a minus and a plus
'Workouts a week. The Workout tab shows how many are left.'
must_not: The minus button active at Off

steps.action: Tap plus three times
user_sees: '3' and 'a week'
must_not: The goal past 7
The home-screen widget still on the old goal

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: Up next says how many workouts are left this week
must_not: A count based on the old goal

start: Settings, Workouts group, or the plate calculator's 'Change plates' link

steps.action: Open 'Plates and bars'
user_sees: Title 'Plates and bars'
Row 'Machine and cable steps' with its choice
'Turn off the plates your gym doesn't have. The plate calculator uses only the ones that are on.'
must_not: Plates shown in kg while the units are lb

steps.action: Turn one plate off, type 1.25 and tap 'Add a plate'
user_sees: The plate is off; 1.25 shows in the list
must_not: The calculator still using the plate that was turned off

steps.action: Pick another bar
user_sees: 'The plate calculator starts on this bar. You can switch it there for one lift.'; the new bar is picked
must_not: The calculator starting on the old bar

steps.action: Tap 'Machine and cable steps' and pick 2.5 or 5 steps
user_sees: The sheet closes; the row shows the new choice
must_not: Suggested machine weights still in the old step

start: Settings, Workouts group

steps.action: Tap 'Rate how hard each set felt' and turn the switch on
user_sees: Caption 'Adds a box to each set: 6 is easy, 10 is as hard as you can go'
must_not: The switch flips back

steps.action: Start a workout and rate a set
user_sees: The set ticks itself and the rest timer starts
must_not: The typed numbers lost after rating
Two ticks for one set

start: Settings, Workouts group

steps.action: Tap 'More workout choices'
user_sees: Title 'More workout choices'; each row with a grey line saying how it is set now
must_not: A grey line that does not match the page behind it

steps.action: Tap 'How the app picks your next weight', change 'Weight step'
user_sees: Title 'How the app picks your next weight', rows 'Weight step' and 'Reps to aim for'
must_not: The next workout's Target ignoring the new step

steps.action: Back, tap 'Previous numbers', pick another source
user_sees: Title 'Previous numbers'; the grey line on More workout choices shows the new source
must_not: Previous numbers still taken from the old source

steps.action: Back, tap 'Muscle tips', turn them off
user_sees: Title 'Muscle tips'; the grey line says off
must_not: Up next still showing a muscle tip

start: Plates and bars page

steps.action: Tap 'Add a plate' with the box empty
user_sees: 'Type a plate weight, like 1.25.'
must_not: A zero plate added

steps.action: Type 999 and tap 'Add a plate'
user_sees: 'Too heavy for a plate. Use <max> <unit> or less.'
must_not: The plate added

steps.action: Type a size that is already on
user_sees: '<n> <unit> plates are already on the list.'
must_not: The same plate twice in the list

steps.action: Turn every plate off
user_sees: 'No plates are on. The calculator will show just the bar.'
must_not: The calculator showing plates that are off
